posts.name: Nuukov
posts.cooked:
I am not sure if this the right topic to post this in...  But I hope it will do ^-^

Firstly I just wanna say quickly how I only found out about Sentinels of the Mutliverse a few days ago via Steam. When I saw it I thought to my self "What the heck, it looks fun - I'm gonna buy it" - so I did. And oh man, I have had so much fun. I love the game, the characters - all of it. In fact, Sentinels is the only game that I enjoyed so much to actually wright a (positive :D) Steam review for. So a big thanks to Christopher for making such an awesome game.

But anyway - as with most games that people play, each of us finds our favourite character(s) - and mine has been Fanatic, by far. So much so that I wanted to recreate her in Champions Online (Superhero MMO). So I did! I slaved over this for over an hour to get her as close as I could.

Sadly, I wanted her to have a sword. I could if I use freeform (those who have played Champions Online will know what I am talking about), and picked the sword as her basic attack, and then used powers from the Radiant, as that would be most fitting. I tried it and it was not very effective. So I just went with the Radiant archetype. I might decide to change that, as I have only just created her. But we will see. No sword for now, sadly.

But either way, pelase tell me what you all think! ^-^
